text.hi: Yeh lesson mein wo questions hain jo har saal CBSE board exams mein repeat hote hain. Objective (MCQ/1-mark) aur Subjective (2-4 marks) dono types cover kiye hain!

content.hi:
CBSE Class 10 Board Exam mein Circles se kitne marks aate hain?
📊 Total Weightage: ~4-6 marks
📝 1-mark questions: Definition ya basic property
📝 2-mark questions: Tangent length nikaalna
📝 3-mark questions: Angle nikaalna using theorems
📝 4-mark questions: Proof ya complex problem

content.en:
How many marks does Circles carry in CBSE Class 10 Board Exam?
📊 Total Weightage: ~4-6 marks
📝 1-mark questions: Definition or basic property
📝 2-mark questions: Finding tangent length
📝 3-mark questions: Finding angles using theorems
📝 4-mark questions: Proof or complex problem
🎯 Important: Proofs of Theorem 10.1 and 10.2 are asked!

content.hi: Circles = Scoring Chapter! Theorems ke proofs yaad rakho!
content.en: Circles = Scoring Chapter! Remember the theorem proofs!

content.hi:
Yeh questions har saal exam mein aate hain:
Q1. Ek point circle ke andar hai toh kitni tangents?  [Ans: 0]
Q2. Tangent radius ke ______ hoti hai.  [Ans: Perpendicular]
Q3. External point se kitni tangents nikalti hain?  [Ans: 2]
Q4. PA aur PB do tangents hain, PA = 10cm, toh PB = ?  [Ans: 10cm]
Q5. ∠AOB + ∠APB = ? (Quadrilateral OAPB mein)  [Ans: 180°]
Q6. Tangent-Chord angle = ?  [Ans: Angle in alternate segment]
Q7. Radius 6cm, distance 10cm, tangent length = ?  [Ans: 8cm]
Q8. Secant circle ko kitne points pe kaat-ti hai?  [Ans: 2]
content.en:
These questions appear in the exam every year:
Q1. How many tangents from a point inside the circle?  [Ans: 0]
Q2. Tangent is ______ to the radius.  [Ans: Perpendicular]
Q3. How many tangents from an external point?  [Ans: 2]
Q4. PA and PB are tangents, PA = 10cm, then PB = ?  [Ans: 10cm]
Q5. ∠AOB + ∠APB = ? (in quadrilateral OAPB)  [Ans: 180°]
Q6. Tangent-Chord angle = ?  [Ans: Angle in alternate segment]
Q7. Radius 6cm, distance 10cm, tangent length = ?  [Ans: 8cm]
Q8. How many points does a secant cut the circle?  [Ans: 2]

content.hi: 💡 Tip: Objective questions mein direct theorem ya formula use karo!
content.en: 💡 Tip: In objective questions, use direct theorem or formula!

content.hi:
Board exam ke liye ye questions practice karo:
📌 Prove karo ki tangent at any point is perpendicular to radius. [4M]
📌 Prove karo ki tangents from external point are equal. [4M]
📌 PA aur PB tangents hain, ∠APB = 80°, toh ∠OAB nikaalo. [3M]
📌 Radius 5cm, tangent length 12cm, toh point ki centre se doori nikaalo. [2M]
📌 Do concentric circles 13cm aur 5cm radius ki ek chord chhoti circle ko touch karti hai. Chord ki length. [3M]
📌 Tangent PQ chord PR ko point P pe milti hai. ∠QPR = 50°, toh arc PR ka centre angle. [3M]
📌 PA = PB = 10cm, OA = 6cm, toh OP aur ∠APB nikaalo. [3M]
content.en:
Practice these questions for the board exam:
📌 Prove that tangent at any point is perpendicular to radius. [4M]
📌 Prove that tangents from external point are equal. [4M]
📌 PA and PB are tangents, ∠APB = 80°, find ∠OAB. [3M]
📌 Radius 5cm, tangent length 12cm, find distance from centre. [2M]
📌 Two concentric circles 13cm and 5cm radius. A chord of larger circle touches smaller. Find chord length. [3M]
📌 Tangent PQ meets chord PR at P. ∠QPR = 50°, find arc PR centre angle. [3M]
📌 PA = PB = 10cm, OA = 6cm, find OP and ∠APB. [3M]

content.hi: In questions ko 2-3 baar practice karo — pattern same rehta hai!

problem.hi: Ek circle ka radius 7cm hai. Ek external point P se do tangents PA aur PB draw ki gayi hain. Agar ∠APB = 60°, toh (i) tangent ki length nikaalo, (ii) OP ki length nikaalo.
problem.en: The radius of a circle is 7cm. Two tangents PA and PB are drawn from an external point P. If ∠APB = 60°, find (i) the length of each tangent, (ii) the length of OP.

steps.hi: Do tangents symmetric hoti hain — OP angles ko bisect karti hai!
steps.en: Two tangents are symmetric — OP bisects the angles!

problem.hi: Prove karo ki do tangents PA aur PB ke beech ka angle ∠APB = 2∠OAB, jahan O circle ka centre hai.
problem.en: Prove that the angle between two tangents PA and PB is ∠APB = 2∠OAB, where O is the centre.

steps.hi: Given: PA aur PB tangents hain, O centre hai
steps.en: Given: PA and PB are tangents, O is centre

steps.hi: 🎯 Is type ke proof questions mein step-by-step theorems aur triangle properties use karo!
steps.en: 🎯 In proof questions, use step-by-step theorems and triangle properties!

problem.hi: Ek circle mein tangent XY point P pe chord PQ ko milti hai. Agar ∠XPQ = 70°, toh arc PQ ke beech ka angle (major arc) nikaalo.
problem.en: In a circle, tangent XY at point P meets chord PQ. If ∠XPQ = 70°, find the angle subtended by arc PQ at the centre (major arc).

steps.hi: Minor arc PQ pe centre angle = 2 × 70° = 140°
steps.en: Centre angle for minor arc PQ = 2 × 70° = 140°
Centre angle for major arc PQ = 360° - 140° = 220°

steps.hi: Minor arc angle = 2 × Tangent-chord angle. Major arc = 360° - Minor arc.
steps.en: Minor arc angle = 2 × Tangent-chord angle. Major arc = 360° - Minor arc.

problem.hi: Do concentric circles hain jinke radii 5cm aur 3cm hain. Bade circle ki ek chord chhote circle ko touch karti hai. Chord ki length nikaalo.
problem.en: Two concentric circles have radii 5cm and 3cm. A chord of the larger circle touches the smaller circle. Find the length of the chord.

steps.hi: Chord AB bade circle ki hai aur chhote circle ko point P pe touch karti hai
steps.en: Chord AB of larger circle touches smaller circle at point P

steps.hi: Chhote circle ke liye AB tangent hai:
steps.en: For smaller circle, AB is a tangent:

steps.hi: So OP ⊥ AB aur OP = r = 3cm
steps.en: So OP ⊥ AB and OP = r = 3cm

steps.hi: 🎯 Concentric circles mein: Chord = 2 × √(R² - r²) — yeh formula direct use kar sakte ho!
steps.en: 🎯 For concentric circles: Chord = 2√(R² - r²) — you can use this formula directly!

explanation.hi: Theorem 10.1: Tangent point of contact pe radius ke perpendicular hoti hai.
explanation.en: Theorem 10.1: Tangent is perpendicular to radius at point of contact.

question.hi: External point se kitni tangents nikalti hain?
question.en: How many tangents from an external point?

explanation.hi: External point se hamesha 2 tangents nikalti hain.
explanation.en: From an external point, always 2 tangents are drawn.

question.hi: PA aur PB do tangents hain. Agar ∠AOB = 100°, toh ∠APB = ?
Point circle ke andar ho toh usse 1 tangent nikalti hai.
question.en: If a point is inside the circle, 1 tangent can be drawn from it.

explanation.hi: Circle ke andar ke point se koi tangent nahi nikalti.
explanation.en: From a point inside the circle, no tangent can be drawn.

question.hi: Radius 8cm, point ki doori 17cm, tangent length = ?
question.en: Radius 8cm, distance from point 17cm, tangent length = ?

question.hi: Do concentric circles ke radii 5cm aur 3cm hain. Bade circle ki chord chhote circle ko touch karti hai. Chord ki length kya hogi?
question.en: Two concentric circles have radii 5cm and 3cm. A chord of larger circle touches smaller. Chord length?

question.hi: Tangent PQ chord PR ko milti hai. ∠QPR = 55°, toh arc PR ka centre angle = ?
question.en: Tangent PQ meets chord PR. ∠QPR = 55°, then arc PR centre angle = ?

question.hi: PA = PB = 12cm, OA = 5cm. OP ki length kya hogi?
question.en: PA = PB = 12cm, OA = 5cm. What is OP?

notes.hi: ✅ Tangent circle ko exactly ONE point pe touch karti hai
notes.en: ✅ A tangent touches a circle at exactly ONE point

notes.hi: ✅ External point se 2 tangents: PA = PB (Theorem 10.2)
notes.en: ✅ Two tangents from external point: PA = PB (Theorem 10.2)

notes.hi: ✅ Alternate Segment Theorem: Tangent-chord angle = Angle in alternate segment
notes.en: ✅ Alternate Segment Theorem: Tangent-chord angle = Angle in alternate segment
